name: mobile-native-design-system
description: Local-first product intelligence, planning, guarded implementation, native design, motion, audit, and typed-token tooling for Flutter, React Native, SwiftUI, and Compose.

interface.shortDescription: Understand, plan, and improve native mobile apps safely.
interface.longDescription: A local-first, mobile-only plugin that reconstructs an app's screens, routes, behavior, state, data boundaries, design language, motion, assets, and tests; creates evidence-backed product and screen plans; and guards one approved native implementation at a time across Flutter, React Native, SwiftUI, and Compose.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $mobile-native-design-system to understand this mobile codebase, plan evidence-backed improvements, and safely implement one approved native screen without changing behavior.
